description: Check one lead alert by seq: its commit status and opBNB transaction, and whether it folds into its anchor. Pass the alert you hold (the row from lead_alerts or from a push, with its salt) as alert and the answer says whether its hash recomputes to the sealed one

alert.description: One alert object exactly as received, with ts, chain, read, direction, hour, price, values and salt. Example: {"ts": 1761350700000, "chain": "bnb", "read": "vol_spike_long", "direction": "long", "hour": 1761346800000, "price": 612.4, "values": {"volumeRatio": 3.1, "macdHist": 0.42}, "salt": "5f2c9a0e1b7d4c3a8e6f0b1d2c3e4f5a"}

seq.description: Sequence number in the CHXL stream, whole number. Example: 7

name: verify_lead_alert
